class.name: NetwPredictFold
class.brief_description: Which input a predicted entity simulates this frame, returned by [method NetwMultiplayer._predict_drive].
class.description: Create one with [method of] in an override of [method NetwMultiplayer._predict_drive]. A frame with no new input repeats the last one. [codeblock] var fold := NetwPredictFold.of(tick, true, NetwPredict.DRIVE_KIND_FRESH) [/codeblock]

method.name: fresh
method.description: [code]true[/code] when this frame uses a new input, [code]false[/code] when it repeats the last one.

method.name: label
method.description: The tick of the input, or the current tick when there is no input.

method.name: of
method.description: Creates a [NetwPredictFold]. [param kind] must be a valid [enum NetwPredict.DriveKind].
